To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

EWS‐FL1 induces TNC expression through direct interaction of the EWS‐ETS chimera with the promoter region of the TNC gene, and that TNC expression correlates with the malignant phenotype of Ewing sarcoma.
EWS‐FL1‐1 and EWS‐ERG induce TNC expression in ES cells.

the EWS‐ETS chimeric proteins upregulate the expression of tenascin C (TNC) through direct interaction with the TNC promoter, and that TNC expression may contribute to the oncogenic effect mediated by the EWS‐FLT1 chimeric protein.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification and characterization of genes that are regulated by the EWS‐ETS chimeric proteins.
the identification and characterization of downstream targets of EWS‐ ETS fusion proteins.
the role of the Ewing sarcoma‐specific fusion proteins in transcriptional regulation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Ewing sarcoma‐associated fusion proteins induce TNC expression by direct interaction with TNC promoter and that this induction may contribute to the oncogenic effect in Ewing sarcoma cells.
the EWS‐ETS oncoprotein is a transcription factor that regulates expression of a subset of target genes including TNC.

the EWS‐ETS chimeric protein upregulates the expression of TNC through direct interaction with the TNC promoter, and this is one of the mechanisms by which the chimeric protein contributes to the tumorigenic phenotype of Ewing sarcoma.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the expression of the EWS‐ETS chimeric proteins in Ewing sarcoma is associated with the induction of tenascin expression, a molecule that promotes the invasive phenotype of cancer cells.
the oncogenic effects of EWS‐FLT‐1 fusion protein may in part be mediated by upregulation of TNC expression through four ETS‐binding sites in the T‐NC promoter.
the EWS‐ETS oncoproteins are aberrant transcription factors that can activate the TNC gene.
The main takeaway from our work is that
EWS‐FL1‐1 is a transcription factor and that it can regulate the expression of genes that are important to cancer development.
the oncogenic activity of EWS‐ETs fusion proteins can be mediated by induction of the TNC gene.
EWS‐FL1 induces TNC expression in Ewing sarcoma cells, and that TNC expression in ES cells is regulated by direct interaction of the EWS‐ETS protein with the TNC promoter.
